links.outcome: Training burden and time savings after brief tool-specific training for pharmacovigilance team
links.effect: A 2-hour training session sufficed for implementation; 23.3% (95% CI 13.8%-32.8%) time saving per case (P<.001).
links.quote: The implementation of MyGenAssist for this activity only required a 2-hour training session for the pharmacovigilance team.

unlisted_practices: Measuring time savings from LLM-drafted pharmacovigilance case documentation letters
Comparing recipient response rates with and without LLM-drafted letters

screen.reason: Empirical real-world deployment study evaluating the operational efficiency and documentation impact of an internal LLM tool (MyGenAssist) in a pharmacovigilance department. It does not test a specific safeguard/practice comparison.
